'''January 2004 Fort Worth tournament''' was an unsanctioned Star Wars CCG tournament held on 31 January 2004 at Y2Komics, 5270 Trail Lake Drive, Fort Worth, Texas, with [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-2701-39879">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39879#39879 Texas Tournament!], Michael Richards, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (26 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318153249/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40276%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-2701-39952">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39952#39952 Texas Tournament!], Michael Richards, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318153249/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40276%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Y2Komics, 5270 Trail Lake Drive, Fort Worth, Texas<ref name="pcf-2701-39879" />
* '''Dates:''' 31 January 2004, 12:00 PM<ref name="pcf-2701-39879" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]<ref name="pcf-2701-39879" />
* '''Structure:''' Swiss, constructed, unlimited card pool; two or three rounds and no final confrontation<ref name="pcf-2701-39879" />
* '''Entry fee:''' one pack<ref name="pcf-2701-39879" />

Each round was two games, one with each side. Richards kept it to two or three rounds because the tournament was for fun and not sanctioned.<ref name="pcf-2701-39952" />
